notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "So...What is Transition?" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — titus.orourke@maine.gov → Titus.Orourke@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Set a job title the way the rest of the site does
decisions.why: 1 job title sits in plain text under the person's name, where 186 elsewhere on the site are in italics — so the same contact block is drawn two ways depending on the page, and the title runs into the name above it. The standard here is the site's own, not a preference: two thirds of these blocks already do it. No word changes.

decisions.label: Left-align a section header
decisions.why: 1 section header is centred, where 1,103 of the 1,139 on the site are left-aligned — the component list says not to centre them. The band runs the full width of the column, so a centred title has no fixed relationship to anything else, and a two-line one breaks the left edge every other heading shares. Only the alignment changes.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.

decisions.label: Eyebrow: "Office of Special Services & Inclusive Education"
